title: Read an optional query
summary: ASP.NET Core: Read an optional query. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: A simple input outside the path can come from the query string. GET /page with no n uses the fallback.
learningObjectives: Read an optional query with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Read an optional query

blocks.text: The nullable query input is absent. The ?? expression supplies 1.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A missing optional number is null, not automatically zero.
